title: CurvFed: Curvature-Aligned Federated Learning for Fairness without Demographics
reasoning: The paper presents a technical framework (CurvFed) for optimizing federated learning to achieve performance-based group fairness in human-sensing applications (using sensor data like WiFi and IMU). While it aims for 'fairness', it treats this as an optimization and statistical problem involving loss-landscape curvature. It does not evaluate or discuss religion, moral reasoning, or philosophical ethical systems.
